situation.robustness_battery_finding: Cycle 1: component wall is a GENUINE clinical gap, not surface overfit. KCL-style OOD (Panel C) barely dents accuracy (87.5%) while minimal-pair/synonym traps (Panels A,B) fail. Model quantifies counts but cannot WITHHOLD quantification when a count does not establish a habitual rate.
situation.weakest_axis: cluster_axis_retention (3 failures across all panels); then provoked/transient/adherence-confound over-quantification and last-event->seizure-free over-inference.

experiment_queue.summary: Cycle 3 showed battery-perfect != distribution-robust (-106 on validation750). Feasibility reality: bare llm_only direct labeler on gpt-4.1-mini is weak (575/750=0.767 validation), low ceiling even with perfect unknown handling. Strong hybrid/selector family scored 733-739 validation but 379/450=0.842 test ON FULL gpt-4.1, not mini. Fork: (a) gated-coerce v0.8 refinement of weak llm_only [low ceiling]; (b) evaluate the strong hybrid/V12 family ON gpt-4.1-mini [more plausible but likely <=379]; (c) calibration test run; (d) reset 0.90 expectation. Surfaced to user.
